reviewer: Codex, explicit review of the saved document bytes and the scopes below
review_kind: source specification only; not data, rights, or production approval

review_scope: Data origin, mart_documents, mart_companies, stg_financial_facts, mart_business_results and update sections
known_limitations: Financial corrections are not reflected; historical coverage is being filled
Company master is replaced with a current snapshot, not dated identifier history
Reference code commit does not establish the data build commit or historical delivery time
assertions_relied_upon: doc_id is the document key; edinet_code and sec_code identify the submitter; parent/status fields describe revisions
stg originates in EDINET type=5 CSV and carries element_id, context_id, value and unit fields
Business results is a normalized comparative-year view, not a new primary source

review_scope: Source, license label, temporal_coverage and financial-coverage declarations only
known_limitations: Coverage and daily update frequency are provider claims, not measured completeness or availability
License label and upstream link do not establish redistribution permission
assertions_relied_upon: EDINET is the declared upstream, so this is derived_from_edinet
JP-FSA-EDINET is the displayed license identifier; rights remain separately unresolved
temporal_coverage starts at 2016-06-23 with no declared end; this is not the measured sample date range

review_scope: Summary selection, relative years, document-wide scope preference and normalized column expressions; reference SQL read, not executed
known_limitations: Provider MAX/COALESCE can collapse candidates and accounting standards; the audit retains ambiguous candidates
No canonical mapping approval; only the existing ten component definitions are traced
Reference SQL is not proof of the observed dataset build version
assertions_relied_upon: SummaryOfBusinessResults tags and CurrentYear/Prior1Year through Prior4Year contexts feed the view
NonConsolidatedMember marks standalone; a document with consolidated rows prefers those rows
IFRS and JP GAAP expressions are coalesced into provider columns and grouped by document and relative year

review_scope: Complete projection and document join; reference SQL read, not executed
known_limitations: Document metadata is reduced to one row per doc_id, not a vintage history
Data build commit remains unknown; saved catalog SQL and raw bytes are separate evidence
assertions_relied_upon: Raw value, element_id, context_id, unit fields, csv_type and row_seq are projected
numeric_value is a DECIMAL(38,4) conversion; raw value is preserved separately
Submitter and period fields come from a doc_id join to document metadata

review_scope: Parquet persistence and restoration section only: export tables, preserved information and limitations
known_limitations: Claims of complete restoration are not original-byte proof
Resolver and raw_facts are not persisted; some statements need taxonomy
This review does not adopt canonical-key extraction, PIT or performance claims elsewhere in README
assertions_relied_upon: The export separates filings, line_items, text_blocks, contexts, dei, calc_edges and def_parents
Text blocks are a separate table; doc_id identifies filings across tables
Calculation relations and a flattened definition parent index are distinct outputs

review_scope: Opening software-license notice and license identity only; no legal rights review
known_limitations: Software licensing does not resolve redistribution rights for derived EDINET rows or upstream material
assertions_relied_upon: The program notice identifies GNU Affero General Public License version 3 or later; record this as a software label only

review_scope: All seven table schema definitions and SCHEMAS mapping; read as source specification without importing provider code
known_limitations: Schema declarations alone cannot prove acquired rows or original locators
def_parents has local concept pairs without namespace, role or complete path; retain unresolved
Duplicate original members or contexts cannot be selected from these declarations alone
assertions_relied_upon: filings carries identifiers, submission timestamp, periods, parent_doc_id and status fields
line_items/text_blocks carry namespace_uri, concept, context_id, unit_ref, period, entity_id, dimensions_json, nil and source_line
contexts and dei preserve separate structure and identifier fields
calc_edges carries role_uri, parent/child href, weight and order; def_parents only doc_id and concept pairs

review_scope: Complete dataset card: provenance, declared coverage, field definitions and license label
known_limitations: Card does not supply namespace, contextRef or historical provider delivery time
2014-2022 and the 2014-06-14 start are provider claims, not audited full coverage
Apache-2.0 display does not settle upstream EDINET rights
assertions_relied_upon: Records are extracted sections of EDINET annual reports, not independent primary evidence
doc_id, edinet_code, optional sec_code, period dates and day-precision submit_date support document matching
tag and text identify extracted blocks; url declares the source but is not a source tie
The dataset card displays apache-2.0 separately from EDINET upstream conditions
